repos_data.description: A fixed income library for pricing bonds and bond futures, and derivatives such as interest rate swaps (IRS), cross-currency swaps (XCS) and FX swaps. Contains tools for full curveset construction with market standard optimisers and automatic differentiation (AD) and risk sensitivity calculations including delta and cross-gamma.
SOFR compounding-in-arrears — ARRC/ISDA conventions, SOFR Index method, compounded average. Reproduces NY Fed published values. Zero deps.
ISDA day-count conventions — 30/360, 30E/360, ACT/360, ACT/365F, ACT/ACT ISDA & ICMA. Zero dependencies.
US TIPS inflation math per 31 CFR 356 App B — reference CPI, index ratios, adjusted principal, deflation floor. Zero dependencies.
US Treasury price math — parse & format 32nds quotes (105-16+), ticks, and basis points. Zero dependencies.
Typed zero-dependency client for the US Treasury's free public APIs — auctions, CUSIP lookups, Debt to the Penny. No API key.
Typed zero-dependency client for the NY Fed Markets Data API — SOFR and friends, averages & index, SOMA. No API key.
US bond-market holidays, early closes, and T+1 settlement dates per SIFMA recommendations. Zero dependencies.
